name: Brenda So
biography: Brenda is a security researcher at Red Balloon Security. She earned her Bachelors in Electrical Engineering at The Cooper Union. She has spoken about reverse engineering at Hushcon West and CSAW. She has also organized the ATM CTF challenge at major conferences such as Recon and Defcon. When not messing around with ATMs, she is brewing a nice gallon of beer at her homebrew setup. @Sosogun3
